# Praxis Landing Page - Next.js Project

## Project Overview
Next.js landing page for Praxis - a special education platform that makes learning accessible through simplified text and emoji-based comprehension checks.

## Tech Stack
- Next.js 15 with App Router
- TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS
- GSAP for animations
- Framer Motion for React animations

## Project Status
- [x] Created copilot-instructions.md file
- [x] Scaffold Next.js project
- [x] Install dependencies (GSAP, Framer Motion)
- [x] Create components and pages
- [x] Add animations and styling
- [x] Test and run project

## Development Guidelines
- Use TypeScript for type safety
- Implement responsive design with Tailwind CSS
- Use GSAP for scroll-based animations
- Use Framer Motion for component animations
- Follow Next.js App Router conventions

## Getting Started

Run the development server:

```bash
npm run dev
```

Open [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000) in your browser to see the result.

## Components Overview

- **Navigation**: Fixed nav with scroll effects and Framer Motion animations
- **Hero**: Gradient hero section with animated text
- **DemoCarousel**: Interactive carousel with GSAP transitions and autoplay
- **Features**: Feature cards with GSAP ScrollTrigger animations
- **ProblemSolution**: Side-by-side problem/solution layout
- **Personas**: User persona cards with glass morphism effect
- **Stats**: Animated statistics with GSAP
- **Pricing**: Pricing cards with featured highlight
- **FinalCTA**: Call-to-action section with gradient background
- **Footer**: Multi-column footer with links
